package.name: drdo_gz_worlds
package.description: Gazebo Harmonic (gz-sim) worlds and terrain models for the DRDO UAV-Guided UGV Navigation challenge, ported from the original ROS1 Noetic / Gazebo Classic 11 package (interiit22/world, interiit22/models). UAV and UGV are spawned as separate models into these worlds; they are not embedded here.
